product.intro: The Harithsa Notes is Vishruth Harithsa’s personal editorial site.
sections: Explore the site
Read articles, browse books and projects, or explore podcasts and the photo gallery.
Read People and Journal
Sign in with the Google account that received an invitation. Contact the site owner if that account cannot open the reading room.
Publish a note
In Workspace, choose a collection, edit a draft, preview it, then publish when it is ready.

technical.intro: Astro and TypeScript power the site, with Firebase services behind the live application.
sections: Request flow

Firebase Hosting serves public assets and routes dynamic requests to a Firebase HTTP function. Firestore stores drafts and published entries. Firebase Storage serves public artwork and holds protected media.
Access and API
Firebase Authentication identifies readers. The application enforces invitations and scoped Content API access.
Observability
The application sends operational telemetry to Dynatrace. Its 404 reporting includes safe request paths and omits raw query strings.

settings.intro: Reader preferences and publishing access apply at different scopes.
sections: Appearance
The site follows the system theme by default. A reader can switch themes in the header. The preference takes effect immediately and is saved in that browser.
Analytics consent
Optional analytics start disabled until the visitor opts in. Consent is stored in the browser.
Invitations
People and Journal requires an invitation and sign-in. Workspace access is limited to the site administrator.

sdlc.intro: Each change is tracked from a GitHub issue through release verification.
sections: Plan and review
Link a pull request to its issue and milestone. Record the documentation impact. The Foundation and Website checks are required on the default branch.
Release and verify
Use Firebase preview when isolated acceptance testing is needed. Verify the deployed runtime and public pages after a production release.

pipeline.intro: The application and documentation have separate publication steps.
sections: If publication fails
Inspect the Pages run, correct the failing stage, and verify the published source revision before reporting success.
stages: Validate project structure, documentation, the Website build and tests.
Merge the reviewed PR into main after required checks.
GitHub Actions publishes the curated docs artifact to Pages. Firebase application releases follow the Firebase release procedure.
Check the public guide URLs and published source revision.
